caveat: Fixed mode: 32 simulations per root candidate for everyone. Time mode: equal 40ms soft compute deadlines, finish a current rollout and cover all root actions; SH uses the published Anytime schedule. Parallel workers affect elapsed time and simulation counts; serial cost data are recorded before tournament workers/tests. Seat rotations share seeds, so games are not independent trials.
stopReason: User requested a longer thinking budget; superseded by a 200ms validation on fresh seeds. This partial suite is not used for strength conclusions.
